description: This file contains functions for managing boot configuration and upgrade preparation for a specific device (Asrock). It includes methods to modify partition data for system upgrades and to set up the environment for a firmware upgrade process.

methods.name: asrock_bootconfig_mangle
methods.description: Modifies the boot configuration partition to set or reset upgrade flags based on the argument ('bootcheck' or 'sysupgrade').

methods.name: asrock_upgrade_prepare
methods.description: Prepares the device for system upgrade by setting the boot configuration and removing specific UBI volumes if they exist.
